The '''North Corridor''' was an area of Cloud City. It was through here that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] escorted the recently [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-froze]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to his ship, [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Fett also took a couple of pot-shots with his blaster at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], after hearing an impatient [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Damaging only a wall, Fett quickly fled.<ref name="TESB" />
